en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.683 - Abd al-Ala, the freedman of Ale Saam, asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about the dimensions of the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah (sw).
Imam (as) said: "It was three thousand and six hundred cubits, broken up (referring to its measured parts)”.
